For React projects

Turing Mirror UI TRM UI

Shared components and design system

TRM UI provides consistent components, colors and interaction rules for Turing Mirror desktop apps. The gallery demonstrates the components and explains interaction, writing and motion. Projects use a verified package version and can retain their existing language and theme settings.

View project ↗（Opens in a new tab） Read integration guide ↗（Opens in a new tab）

The gallery runs in a browser. Running the Tauri desktop shell requires Rust.

Interactive examples

Features

  • Shared components

    Buttons, forms, menus, tooltips and dialogs are maintained in one package. Products receive improvements by updating their dependency.

  • Interactive design guidance

    The gallery covers interaction, writing, typography, color and motion, and records replaced designs and the reasons for each change.

  • Continuous interaction

    Segmented controls support dragging. Filtered lists retain existing items, and panels resize continuously as content changes.

  • Eight languages and theme settings

    Common interface text is available in eight languages. Products can connect their translations and use shared color variables or their own theme.

Getting started

  1. Preview the gallery

    Get the project, run npm install and npm run dev, then open the local preview URL in a browser.

  2. Install the package

    Follow the integration guide to install trm-ui at a pinned commit, import the required components and styles, and connect your language settings.

  3. Verify and update

    After updating the package, check the product build and interactions before releasing the product update.
